item.summary: fix(ui): retire the local model override once the Gateway confirms the patch (#124005) * fix(ui): retire the local model override once the Gateway confirms the patch settleModelOverride re-asserted the requested model into the shared override map after every successful patch, and the reader prefers the map over the server row unconditionally — so any external model change (second operator window, channel /model, fallback rotation persisted by the Gateway) never reached this window's picker or its effective-tools key for the rest of the connection. The refreshed row already carries the confirmed selection; retire the entry instead of shadowing the recorded fact. deferListRefresh callers keep the published value (their refresh has not run), rollbacks and newer-claim transfers are untouched. * test(ui): split model-override lifecycle coverage into a focused file (max-lines)
